text:
Asha: Quick sync — finalizing screening rubric + launch guardrails for design partner cohort. Proposal: 6 customers, 4 integrations max at a time, 6-week program. Need: recruitment incentives, clear success metrics, and consent form. Doc: https://notion.redwood/design-partner-plan

Jae: +1 on 6. For incentives thinking credits + early access to roadmap sessions. Budget? ~ $6k total.

María: For research: want 3 prototyping touchpoints (week 1, week 3, week 6) and in-product telemetry. Will send sample interview guide.

Ethan: Engineering note: we can safely onboard 3 integrations in parallel given current infra. If we exceed, we need a staggered schedule or dedicate a short-lived dedicated capacity pool. Also KMS questions for logs.

Ben: Screening rubric (quick):
```
- Product-fit: 0-3 (active LLM use)
- Technical: 0-3 (has infra + data access)
- Commitment: 0-2 (weekly calls + triage)
- Impact: 0-2 (business relevance)
```
Aim >=7.

Sophie: Success metrics suggestion: weekly active users, tokens/hour, integration completion rate, support tickets triaged <48h, NPS > 7. Weekly 5-question pulse + closing survey.

María: Feedback loop cadence: async thread + weekly 30m touchpoints + mid-program demo. Notion template for issues + prioritization tags.

Ethan: Confirm: data collection will be opt-in; we need consent + data retention window. I'll add a checklist: KMS, Pseudonymize, Logs retention 90d.

deploy-bot: New doc created: design-partner-plan-v3 — https://notion.redwood/design-partner-plan

Asha: Proposed next steps: finalize rubric by EOD Wednesday, Jae to confirm budget, Sophie to draft pulse survey, Ethan to add infra checklist. Sync Wed 11am. :thumbsup:
